name: furniture_bench_dataset_raw
description: A raw dataset focused on furniture-related visual data intended to support tasks such as object detection, segmentation, and 3D pose/reconstruction for furniture items. The collection provides imagery and associated annotations/raw sensor outputs to enable research in scene understanding and manipulation of furniture objects. It is presented as a raw resource for researchers to preprocess for specific vision or robotics tasks rather than a single fixed-evaluation benchmark.
evaluation_method: mAP / IoU for detection/segmentation; pose error metrics (e.g., ADD) or task_success_rate for manipulation tasks (task-dependent)
reputation: A domain-specific dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use among researchers working on furniture perception and manipulation.
